senses.zh_definition: 奥德丽：英语来源的女性名字，规范书写形式为Audrey；属于专有名词。
senses.en_definition: Audrey, a feminine given name of English origin.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi perempuan yang berasal daripada bahasa Inggeris dan ditulis dengan huruf awal besar, Audrey.
senses.nuances: pos中的noun具体指专有名词，即kata nama khas。它不是已由输入资料确认的马来语普通词，故status标记为proper_name；马来语释义为编辑说明，不冒称DBP原文。下列搭配为人名称呼及常见句法框架，不是固定词汇搭配。来源：[Oxford：Audrey](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/audrey)。

etymology.historical_story: Audrey developed from earlier forms of Etheldreda, connected with an Old English personal name whose elements mean noble and strength. Saint Etheldreda, associated with Ely, helped preserve the name in cultural memory. This is the history of an English personal name, not a Malay derivational formula or a description of everyone bearing it. See [Audrey: etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Audrey).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到近似“奥德丽”的/ˈɔːdri/，先想到一个人的名字；写作Audrey，大写A，不拆成马来语词缀。
